entries.mechanism: Both legs run at 2026 law. The Axiom target is the flat 4.40 percent section 39-22-104(1.7)(c) base tax on completed Colorado taxable income, scoped before section 39-22-627 temporary rate adjustments and all credits; TAXSIM's siitax models final Colorado liability including its smooth TABOR-style refund estimate and any 627 adjustment. The residual is that documented scope wedge, pinned per case.
